editorial:
Imagine being in the middle of a fancy golf course when a couple starts fighting right in front of you. That is exactly where Stig-Helmer finds himself. He is a lovable, clumsy guy who knows absolutely nothing about golf, but he suddenly becomes the center of a huge bet. A businessman thinks he can train any random person to beat his girlfriend in a week, and poor Stig-Helmer is the chosen guinea pig. Along with his Norwegian buddy Ole, he dives into the world of country clubs and expensive gear. It is a lighthearted, silly ride that focuses more on the funny situations than the actual sport.

You will love how the movie pokes fun at the snobby culture of golf. The acting is great because it feels natural and not forced. While the plot is simple, the physical comedy keeps you laughing the whole time. Some parts might feel a bit slow, but the payoff is worth it. If you want a relaxing night in, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move for a rainy day.
endingExplained: In the final big match, Stig-Helmer uses his own strange and unconventional way of playing. While he does not play like a pro, his luck and odd style actually work. He manages to beat the opponent and win the bet, proving that you do not need to be fancy to succeed. Everyone is shocked by the result, and the movie ends on a high note with Stig-Helmer remaining his true, quirky self.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves underdog stories and goofy humor.
